review.notes: Word-level diff of the PDF text layer against the OCR markdown for all 11 physical pages plus a whole-document digit-token inventory (residual tokens are image-filename hashes, math tokenization, and reference URL dot-splits). Code-fence scan found no fences; all headings are the paper's printed uppercase section titles. No footnote bodies exist in this paper (references are unnumbered in print, verified on a p.9 render). The flow-matching equations and inline LaTeX match the printed math; hyphenation artifacts (cutting-edge, text-to-image, multi-stage, audio-driven, OCR-based, cross-attention, DiT-based, subjective split across the p.3/p.4 page break) were left unchanged. Fréchet in the OCR matches the print (combining-accent artifact only).
